jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Cloud Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Aerospike is powering the next generation of real-time, massive-scale applications—and we need an exceptional Director of Engineering to build the gateway to it all. You will own the vision, architecture, and execution for how thousands of developers and enterprise teams interact with, pay for, and observe the Aerospike Cloud Platform.
This isn't just about managing code; it’s about shaping the entire developer journey across our multi-cloud, multi-tenant ecosystem. You will lead the charge on everything from lightning-fast UI/API experiences to complex usage-based monetization and real-time telemetry pipelines handling massive data flows.
To foster strong alignment and execution, Bay Area–based leaders are expected in-office Tuesday through Thursday.
We need a high-octane strategic leader who loves big technical challenges, thrives on building high-impact teams, and stays close enough to the tech to drive serious architectural authority. Partnering directly with executive leaders in Product, Design, Finance, and Infrastructure, you will transform complex, distributed database capabilities into an effortless, intuitive, and wildly reliable cloud service.

What You’ll Do

Build & Scale a World-Class Org:
Empower, mentor, and grow a premier organization of engineering managers, technical leads, and full-stack/frontend engineers. Drive a high-velocity culture rooted in innovation, autonomy, and delivery.
Revolutionize the Customer Experience:
Define the multi-year vision for our developer consoles, APIs, and user-facing workflows—ensuring every interaction with Aerospike Cloud is fast, friction-free, and delightful.
Architect the Core Business Engine (BLT):

Monetization & Usage:
Spearhead the architectural evolution of our high-volume billing engines, real-time usage tracking, and multi-cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure, Stripe).
Licensing & Entitlements:
Build bulletproof, multi-tenant entitlement systems and feature-gating frameworks designed for global enterprise scale.
Telemetry & Observability:
Drive the strategy for deep, real-time observability (metrics, logs, traces) that turns billions of platform events into actionable insights for both our engineers and customers.
Drive Technical Excellence:
Serve as the ultimate bar-raiser for microservices architecture, API design, and modern frontend systems. Keep the tech stack cutting-edge while eliminating complexity.
Align Tech with Business Growth:
Translate big-picture enterprise strategy into clear, executable technical roadmaps alongside Product, Revenue, and Executive Leadership.
Own Production Reliability:
Establish non-negotiable standards for billing precision, sub-second interface performance, and enterprise-grade SLA availability in a 24/7/365 cloud environment.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years
scaling customer-facing SaaS, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure platforms at serious velocity.
4+ years
of progressive engineering leadership experience, with a proven track record of managing managers, scaling teams, and leading through technical leads.
Domain Powerhouse:
Deep expertise in architecting cloud monetization engines (metered billing, marketplace integrations) and high-throughput telemetry/observability platforms (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus).
Deep Technical DNA:
Hands-on foundation in modern web stacks (React, TypeScript), scalable API design (REST, GraphQL), and cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Go, multi-cloud platforms).
Executive Presence & Business Acumen:
A clear, compelling communicator who seamlessly connects deep technical architecture to revenue strategy, product execution, and executive goals.
Battle-Tested Operational Ownership:
Proven experience running high-availability, mission-critical production systems where downtime or inaccuracy is not an option.

Nice to Have

Experience building developer consoles, control planes, or management interfaces for NoSQL databases, data platforms, or high-throughput infrastructure.
Direct experience leading engineering through periods of rapid scaling, enterprise transformations, or major cloud platform expansions.
Hands-on familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or technologies like Temporal and Node.js.
Familiarity with distributed systems or high-scale databases.

Salary Range
: $272,000 – $350,000
(Actual compensation will be based on experience, location, and other relevant factors.)

jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

As the Global Software Leader for Acute Products/ Devices, this role is responsible for leading multi-site device software engineering team for Acute Care products by defining and driving software strategy and implementation and delivering to all Acute Care product lines. As the Global Device Software Leader for Acute Care product lines of Vantive, works in collaboration with commercial, systems, program management, Quality & Regulatory functional leadership teams to build and execute on product strategy, roadmaps and delivery plans.

Own product-line software strategy and roadmaps for device software for all acute products; aligning with business and product strategy and therapy needs.
Lead Acute global device software team, including functional managers and technical leaders.
Lead defining and implementing technology and software architecture strategy working with Acute device software leaders and in collaboration with systems leaders
Lead Acute global device software team in building execution plans and driving execution to deliver to the product roadmaps and releases across all Acute product lines.
Create, effectively communicate, and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and customer needs.
Establish an organization structure that ensures clear accountability and operational excellence.
Develop and mentor high-performing managers and technical leaders; build succession plans and communities of practice across global sites.
Provide strategic planning leadership for resource staffing and project execution with proactive management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments

jobs.title: Executive Director, Application Development – Telematics (P&C Insurance Technology)
jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

This is far more than an application development leadership role. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of how USAA understands risk, serves members, and competes in an increasingly data-driven insurance marketplace.

As Executive Director, Application Development - Telematics
, you will report directly to the AVP of P&C Policy Core Systems and Technical Services and lead a growing organization of approximately 45 employees and 50 contractor resources responsible for one of USAA's most strategically important and rapidly evolving technology capabilities. Reporting to Aaron Bend, AVP of Policy Core Systems and Technical Services, you will own the technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and future evolution of USAA's telematics ecosystem, helping transform vast amounts of driving behavior, connected vehicle, mobile application, and sensor data into actionable insights that improve pricing accuracy, claims outcomes, risk segmentation, fraud detection, member experiences, and overall business performance.

The timing of this opportunity is particularly compelling. Telematics has evolved from a niche capability into a foundational component of USAA's Personal Auto business. Today, telematics data influences pricing decisions on more than half of USAA's quoted and issued auto insurance policies, and the organization continues to invest aggressively in expanding telematics-driven capabilities across pricing, underwriting, claims, and member engagement. Through strategic partnerships with telematics providers, automotive OEMs, and leading technology partners, USAA is accelerating its ability to leverage real-time data to create a more personalized, proactive, and intelligent insurance experience.

The Executive Director will play a central role in advancing cloud-native technologies, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to unlock new sources of business value from telematics data. The role will help expand the use of telematics beyond pricing and underwriting into areas such as claims automation, crash detection, first-notice-of-loss acceleration, risk prevention, and member engagement, while also supporting the long-term evolution of USAA's telematics platform and data ecosystem.

Looking ahead, this position offers the opportunity to influence how USAA evolves beyond traditional telematics into a broader connected ecosystem. As connected vehicles, smart devices, sensors, and Internet of Things technologies continue to reshape the industry, USAA is exploring new ways to leverage data to improve member outcomes across both Auto and Property insurance, including Connected Home capabilities designed to proactively help members prevent losses before they occur.

For accomplished technology leaders from leading insurers, telematics providers, connected vehicle platforms, mobility technology companies, or other data-driven organizations, this represents a rare opportunity to move beyond managing an established program and help define the future direction of an increasingly strategic enterprise capability. The successful candidate will influence multi-year business and technology roadmaps, partner directly with senior leaders across technology and the business, and help determine how telematics, artificial intelligence, and emerging data ecosystems shape the future of insurance at USAA.

Few opportunities offer this combination of strategic visibility, technical complexity, business impact, and innovation. The work spans cloud modernization, AI, machine learning, mobile technologies, data engineering, vehicle integrations, digital experiences, pricing, underwriting, claims, and connected-device ecosystems, all within an organization making significant long-term investments in these capabilities.

For executives who are already successful and not actively considering a career move, this opportunity offers something increasingly rare: the chance to build and scale a transformative capability at an organization where telematics is already influencing core business decisions and is expected to play an even larger role in the future. The leader selected for this role will have a unique opportunity to help define how USAA leverages connected data, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to better serve millions of members and strengthen its competitive position for years to come.

Executive Directors in Application Development plan, coordinate, and supervise all activities related to the design, development, and implementation and maintenance of the organization's applications development and analysis function. These leaders also manage multiple development teams often supporting one or more lines of business or business functional areas. Additionally, these leaders work closely with clients in order to map and support their operational needs. These leaders are also responsible for developing, distributing, supporting, enforcing, and integrating best practices and technology standards across the organization, including ensuring all Information Technology General Controls, processes and procedures are followed as applicable and appropriate.

Location

USAA offers a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: Plano, TX (preference) or San Antonio, TX. Relocation assistance is available for this position.

What You'll Do

Perform workload management and prioritization duties in support of operations for the functional area assigned.
Apply subject-matter-expert functional knowledge to lead subordinate workers in producing work deliverables in support of departmental initiatives.
Develop functional policies, procedures and guidelines.
Identify opportunities and facilitates major improvements to processes and systems.
Ensure that the assigned application group develops processes and tools that contribute to the company business objectives.
Ensure that all application processes developed internally or by external service providers are conducted in line with corporate social responsibility, environmental and technical policies and applicable standards and legislation.
Oversee the assessment of the technical and business fitness of the application portfolio and their associated costs and risks In partnership with CTO, Infrastructure and IT Security, and ensure that the organization's applications are effectively secured and that risks are mitigated and comply with legal and corporate privacy and confidentiality rules.
Establish management routines to ensure appropriate oversight of the organization's software development and maintenance activities.
Serve as financial steward for the organization and manage relationships with major vendors and service providers to ensure they cost-effectively meet the needs of the organization.
Evaluate and select third party vendors to provide value added services.
Facilitate the contracting process through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) enterprise process.
Responsible for contract company/service performance providing timely feedback to ensure the best value for USAA.
Collaborate with CTO to ensure that solutions are consistent with technology standards.
Work across IT and business partners to reduce technical debt.
Collaborate with other leaders and/or stakeholders and develop an application development strategy that aligns with business strategy, adds value and is within budget constraints.
Responsible for team's adherence to SDLC and applicable controls.
Work to ensure teams have appropriate, development plans consistent with domain of expertise.
Mentor across the technical community.
Provide oversight to the engagement with the business DPO and ensure deliverables adhere to Agile practices / methodologies.
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, I.S., or related field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
10 years of experience of general IT management competencies.
4 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and/or developing high-performing teams required.
Strong technical background of web-based application architecture, system and database architecture, security application integration and object-oriented languages in a large enterprise environment.
Experience in all stages of the SDLC: requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.
Experience collaborating with resources and stakeholders, influencing decisions and managing work to achieve strategic goals.
Experienced in vendor contract management and management of distributed development teams and resources.
Financial acumen involving budgets, forecasting, and executing on the budgets for applicable technology support function.
Understanding of relevant industry frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL, SAFe, etc.)
Understanding of Legislative and Regulatory Compliance Requirements.
Experience overseeing the technology life cycle from requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, design, code, documentation, testing, implementation, and support.
Technical knowledge and understanding of technical domains that reside within Infrastructure Services, Security, Data or Application Development.
Experience conducting cost benefit analyses and leveraging results to drive technology support solutions.
Demonstrated thought leadership in embedding intuitive story telling of technology support functions including concise presentation of complex technical details.
Experience and ability to drive a culture of quality and personal accountability through technology support teams.

What Sets You Apart

5+ years of experience in behavior and usage-based insurance technology or telematics programs.
3+ years of experience modernizing legacy insurance systems to public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Domain experience with usage-based and behavior-based insurance, personal lines insurance, and personal lines claims.
Experience leading the technical strategy and delivery of telematics solutions for P&C, maintaining and building relationships with ecosystem partners, and translating telematic data into higher value using AI.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders in building multi-year roadmaps across P&C functional areas to advance the telematics architecture that supports multi-product capabilities.
Experience scaling data platforms that ingest massive telematics streams (e.g., Mobile app data, IoT device data, OEM vehicle data) and using near real-time data for multiple insurance use cases.
Experience building mobile app experiences tailored to telematic insurance programs.
Experience partnering with key industry telematic suppliers (e.g., CMT, Arity, Okto) or vehicle OEMs.
Experience using machine learning or advanced models to turn telematics data into risk scoring, analytical insights, pricing segmentation, claims detection, or customer engagement tools.
Experience leading the technical strategy to deliver telematic solutions at top insurance carriers.

You will own the strategy and execution of MongoDB's ISV partner program across a team of partner managers, covering both industry-specific ISVs in verticals like financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, and manufacturing, and horizontal AI-native ISVs building platforms and tools that serve builders across industries.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance. You will set the strategic direction for how MongoDB identifies, activates, and scales ISV partnerships, while staying close enough to the work to directly influence key relationships, shape partner agreements, and coach your team through complex deals. You will be expected to operate as a player-coach: intellectually involved in the most important partnerships, hands-on when the moment calls for it, and consistently raising the bar for what good looks like on your team.

This is a greenfield program. You will have real ownership over how it is built, the methodology your team follows, how success is defined and measured, and how the function earns credibility with Sales, Product, and executive leadership. The opportunity is significant for the right leader.

This role can be based remotely in the United States.

What You'll Do

Strategy and Program Leadership

Define and own the strategic framework for MongoDB's ISV partner program, including segmentation across vertical and horizontal ISV categories, prioritization criteria, and the GTM approach for each partner tier
Build and evolve the program infrastructure: onboarding processes, partner playbooks, co-sell frameworks, success metrics, and the internal operating model that connects ISV partnerships to MongoDB's revenue motion
Set the vision for how ISV partnerships contribute to MongoDB's growth, and communicate that vision clearly to executive leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and your team

Player-Coach Execution

Stay personally engaged in the most strategically important partner relationships, including leading or co-leading negotiations, shaping joint value propositions, and representing MongoDB in senior-level partner conversations
Identify early signals of partnership potential or risk across your team's portfolio and step in directly when a deal or relationship needs senior attention
Model the behavior you expect from your team, including intellectual rigor in partner evaluation, commercial discipline in deal structuring, and a bias toward outcomes over activity

Team Development

Lead, develop, and retain a team of Partner Managers, providing strategic direction, deal coaching, and career development that helps each person grow into a stronger partnership professional
Establish clear expectations for performance, build a culture of accountability, and create space for your team to do their best work without micromanagement
Contribute to future team hiring and organizational design as the ISV program scales

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Pre-Sales leadership to align ISV partnership strategy with MongoDB's broader go-to-market priorities
Serve as the internal advocate for the ISV partner motion, educating field sellers on how to co-sell with ISV partners and working with Product to influence the roadmap based on partner ecosystem needs
Present program performance, strategic priorities, and resource needs to senior leadership on a regular basis

Ecosystem Positioning

Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving ISV landscape, including which vertical markets and AI-native platforms represent the highest-value partnership opportunities for MongoDB
Represent MongoDB externally at industry events, partner summits, and customer conversations to build visibility and accelerate business development

Experienced Leader: 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or ISV program management, including at least four years managing a team of partnership professionals at a technology company
Strategic and Executional: You can think at a program and portfolio level while remaining credible and effective in individual partner conversations. You do not treat these as separate skills
Player-Coach: You are not a manager who delegates and monitors. You stay in the work, bring your own expertise to bear on complex situations, and understand that your direct involvement often unlocks outcomes your team cannot reach alone
Program Builder: You have built or significantly scaled a partner program before. You know what the foundation needs to look like, how to sequence the work, and how to earn internal buy-in for a new motion
Commercially Sophisticated: You have structured complex partnership agreements, understand co-sell economics, and can evaluate partner ROI in a way that stands up to scrutiny from Finance and Sales leadership
Talent Developer: You take the growth of your team seriously. You give direct feedback, invest in developing people's skills, and create an environment where strong performers want to stay
Executive Communicator: You write and speak with clarity at the executive level. You can distill a complex partner portfolio into a clear strategic narrative and present it confidently to senior leadership

Establish working relationships with key internal stakeholders. Define initial program priorities and communicate them to your team and leadership
6 Months: Activate a first cohort of high-priority ISV partnerships with defined value propositions and early co-sell plans in motion. Establish team operating rhythm, performance expectations, and early program infrastructure. Begin demonstrating partner-influenced pipeline
12 Months: Deliver measurable business impact through ISV partner pipeline contribution, validated co-sell plays, and a growing set of active field relationships. Have a clear program framework in place with buy-in from Sales and Product leadership. Build and retain a high-performing team

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

This is far more than an application development leadership role. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of how USAA understands risk, serves members, and competes in an increasingly data-driven insurance marketplace.

As Executive Director, Application Development - Telematics
, you will report directly to the AVP of P&C Policy Core Systems and Technical Services and lead a growing organization of approximately 45 employees and 50 contractor resources responsible for one of USAA's most strategically important and rapidly evolving technology capabilities. Reporting to Aaron Bend, AVP of Policy Core Systems and Technical Services, you will own the technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and future evolution of USAA's telematics ecosystem, helping transform vast amounts of driving behavior, connected vehicle, mobile application, and sensor data into actionable insights that improve pricing accuracy, claims outcomes, risk segmentation, fraud detection, member experiences, and overall business performance.

The timing of this opportunity is particularly compelling. Telematics has evolved from a niche capability into a foundational component of USAA's Personal Auto business. Today, telematics data influences pricing decisions on more than half of USAA's quoted and issued auto insurance policies, and the organization continues to invest aggressively in expanding telematics-driven capabilities across pricing, underwriting, claims, and member engagement. Through strategic partnerships with telematics providers, automotive OEMs, and leading technology partners, USAA is accelerating its ability to leverage real-time data to create a more personalized, proactive, and intelligent insurance experience.

The Executive Director will play a central role in advancing cloud-native technologies, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced analytics to unlock new sources of business value from telematics data. The role will help expand the use of telematics beyond pricing and underwriting into areas such as claims automation, crash detection, first-notice-of-loss acceleration, risk prevention, and member engagement, while also supporting the long-term evolution of USAA's telematics platform and data ecosystem.

Looking ahead, this position offers the opportunity to influence how USAA evolves beyond traditional telematics into a broader connected ecosystem. As connected vehicles, smart devices, sensors, and Internet of Things technologies continue to reshape the industry, USAA is exploring new ways to leverage data to improve member outcomes across both Auto and Property insurance, including Connected Home capabilities designed to proactively help members prevent losses before they occur.

For accomplished technology leaders from leading insurers, telematics providers, connected vehicle platforms, mobility technology companies, or other data-driven organizations, this represents a rare opportunity to move beyond managing an established program and help define the future direction of an increasingly strategic enterprise capability. The successful candidate will influence multi-year business and technology roadmaps, partner directly with senior leaders across technology and the business, and help determine how telematics, artificial intelligence, and emerging data ecosystems shape the future of insurance at USAA.

Few opportunities offer this combination of strategic visibility, technical complexity, business impact, and innovation. The work spans cloud modernization, AI, machine learning, mobile technologies, data engineering, vehicle integrations, digital experiences, pricing, underwriting, claims, and connected-device ecosystems, all within an organization making significant long-term investments in these capabilities.

For executives who are already successful and not actively considering a career move, this opportunity offers something increasingly rare: the chance to build and scale a transformative capability at an organization where telematics is already influencing core business decisions and is expected to play an even larger role in the future. The leader selected for this role will have a unique opportunity to help define how USAA leverages connected data, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to better serve millions of members and strengthen its competitive position for years to come.

Executive Directors in Application Development plan, coordinate, and supervise all activities related to the design, development, and implementation and maintenance of the organization's applications development and analysis function. These leaders also manage multiple development teams often supporting one or more lines of business or business functional areas. Additionally, these leaders work closely with clients in order to map and support their operational needs. These leaders are also responsible for developing, distributing, supporting, enforcing, and integrating best practices and technology standards across the organization, including ensuring all Information Technology General Controls, processes and procedures are followed as applicable and appropriate.

Location

USAA offers a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: Plano, TX (preference) or San Antonio, TX. Relocation assistance is available for this position.

What You'll Do

Perform workload management and prioritization duties in support of operations for the functional area assigned.
Apply subject-matter-expert functional knowledge to lead subordinate workers in producing work deliverables in support of departmental initiatives.
Develop functional policies, procedures and guidelines.
Identify opportunities and facilitates major improvements to processes and systems.
Ensure that the assigned application group develops processes and tools that contribute to the company business objectives.
Ensure that all application processes developed internally or by external service providers are conducted in line with corporate social responsibility, environmental and technical policies and applicable standards and legislation.
Oversee the assessment of the technical and business fitness of the application portfolio and their associated costs and risks In partnership with CTO, Infrastructure and IT Security, and ensure that the organization's applications are effectively secured and that risks are mitigated and comply with legal and corporate privacy and confidentiality rules.
Establish management routines to ensure appropriate oversight of the organization's software development and maintenance activities.
Serve as financial steward for the organization and manage relationships with major vendors and service providers to ensure they cost-effectively meet the needs of the organization.
Evaluate and select third party vendors to provide value added services.
Facilitate the contracting process through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) enterprise process.
Responsible for contract company/service performance providing timely feedback to ensure the best value for USAA.
Collaborate with CTO to ensure that solutions are consistent with technology standards.
Work across IT and business partners to reduce technical debt.
Collaborate with other leaders and/or stakeholders and develop an application development strategy that aligns with business strategy, adds value and is within budget constraints.
Responsible for team's adherence to SDLC and applicable controls.
Work to ensure teams have appropriate, development plans consistent with domain of expertise.
Mentor across the technical community.
Provide oversight to the engagement with the business DPO and ensure deliverables adhere to Agile practices / methodologies.
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, I.S., or related field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
10 years of experience of general IT management competencies.
4 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and/or developing high-performing teams required.
Strong technical background of web-based application architecture, system and database architecture, security application integration and object-oriented languages in a large enterprise environment.
Experience in all stages of the SDLC: requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and implementation.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to a non-technical audience.
Experience collaborating with resources and stakeholders, influencing decisions and managing work to achieve strategic goals.
Experienced in vendor contract management and management of distributed development teams and resources.
Financial acumen involving budgets, forecasting, and executing on the budgets for applicable technology support function.
Understanding of relevant industry frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ITIL, SAFe, etc.)
Understanding of Legislative and Regulatory Compliance Requirements.
Experience overseeing the technology life cycle from requirements analysis, feasibility estimates, design, code, documentation, testing, implementation, and support.
Technical knowledge and understanding of technical domains that reside within Infrastructure Services, Security, Data or Application Development.
Experience conducting cost benefit analyses and leveraging results to drive technology support solutions.
Demonstrated thought leadership in embedding intuitive story telling of technology support functions including concise presentation of complex technical details.
Experience and ability to drive a culture of quality and personal accountability through technology support teams.

What Sets You Apart

5+ years of experience in behavior and usage-based insurance technology or telematics programs.
3+ years of experience modernizing legacy insurance systems to public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Domain experience with usage-based and behavior-based insurance, personal lines insurance, and personal lines claims.
Experience leading the technical strategy and delivery of telematics solutions for P&C, maintaining and building relationships with ecosystem partners, and translating telematic data into higher value using AI.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders in building multi-year roadmaps across P&C functional areas to advance the telematics architecture that supports multi-product capabilities.
Experience scaling data platforms that ingest massive telematics streams (e.g., Mobile app data, IoT device data, OEM vehicle data) and using near real-time data for multiple insurance use cases.
Experience building mobile app experiences tailored to telematic insurance programs.
Experience partnering with key industry telematic suppliers (e.g., CMT, Arity, Okto) or vehicle OEMs.
Experience using machine learning or advanced models to turn telematics data into risk scoring, analytical insights, pricing segmentation, claims detection, or customer engagement tools.
Experience leading the technical strategy to deliver telematic solutions at top insurance carriers.

MongoDB is standing up a dedicated ISV Partnerships function, and this Director role is the leadership seat at the center of that effort. You will own the strategy and execution of MongoDB's ISV partner program across a team of partner managers, covering both industry-specific ISVs in verticals like financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, and manufacturing, and horizontal AI-native ISVs building platforms and tools that serve builders across industries.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance. You will set the strategic direction for how MongoDB identifies, activates, and scales ISV partnerships, while staying close enough to the work to directly influence key relationships, shape partner agreements, and coach your team through complex deals. You will be expected to operate as a player-coach: intellectually involved in the most important partnerships, hands-on when the moment calls for it, and consistently raising the bar for what good looks like on your team.

This is a greenfield program. You will have real ownership over how it is built, the methodology your team follows, how success is defined and measured, and how the function earns credibility with Sales, Product, and executive leadership. The opportunity is significant for the right leader.

This role can be based remotely in the United States.

What You'll Do

Strategy and Program Leadership

Define and own the strategic framework for MongoDB's ISV partner program, including segmentation across vertical and horizontal ISV categories, prioritization criteria, and the GTM approach for each partner tier
Build and evolve the program infrastructure: onboarding processes, partner playbooks, co-sell frameworks, success metrics, and the internal operating model that connects ISV partnerships to MongoDB's revenue motion
Set the vision for how ISV partnerships contribute to MongoDB's growth, and communicate that vision clearly to executive leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and your team

Player-Coach Execution

Stay personally engaged in the most strategically important partner relationships, including leading or co-leading negotiations, shaping joint value propositions, and representing MongoDB in senior-level partner conversations
Identify early signals of partnership potential or risk across your team's portfolio and step in directly when a deal or relationship needs senior attention
Model the behavior you expect from your team, including intellectual rigor in partner evaluation, commercial discipline in deal structuring, and a bias toward outcomes over activity

Team Development

Lead, develop, and retain a team of Partner Managers, providing strategic direction, deal coaching, and career development that helps each person grow into a stronger partnership professional
Establish clear expectations for performance, build a culture of accountability, and create space for your team to do their best work without micromanagement
Contribute to future team hiring and organizational design as the ISV program scales

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Pre-Sales leadership to align ISV partnership strategy with MongoDB's broader go-to-market priorities
Serve as the internal advocate for the ISV partner motion, educating field sellers on how to co-sell with ISV partners and working with Product to influence the roadmap based on partner ecosystem needs
Present program performance, strategic priorities, and resource needs to senior leadership on a regular basis

Ecosystem Positioning

Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving ISV landscape, including which vertical markets and AI-native platforms represent the highest-value partnership opportunities for MongoDB
Represent MongoDB externally at industry events, partner summits, and customer conversations to build visibility and accelerate business development

Who You Are

Experienced Leader: 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or ISV program management, including at least four years managing a team of partnership professionals at a technology company
Strategic and Executional: You can think at a program and portfolio level while remaining credible and effective in individual partner conversations. You do not treat these as separate skills
Player-Coach: You are not a manager who delegates and monitors. You stay in the work, bring your own expertise to bear on complex situations, and understand that your direct involvement often unlocks outcomes your team cannot reach alone
Program Builder: You have built or significantly scaled a partner program before. You know what the foundation needs to look like, how to sequence the work, and how to earn internal buy-in for a new motion
Commercially Sophisticated: You have structured complex partnership agreements, understand co-sell economics, and can evaluate partner ROI in a way that stands up to scrutiny from Finance and Sales leadership
Talent Developer: You take the growth of your team seriously. You give direct feedback, invest in developing people's skills, and create an environment where strong performers want to stay
Executive Communicator: You write and speak with clarity at the executive level. You can distill a complex partner portfolio into a clear strategic narrative and present it confidently to senior leadership

Success Measures

3 Months: Develop a strong grasp of MongoDB's product, sales motion, and competitive position. Assess the existing state of ISV partnerships and opportunities. Establish working relationships with key internal stakeholders. Define initial program priorities and communicate them to your team and leadership
6 Months: Activate a first cohort of high-priority ISV partnerships with defined value propositions and early co-sell plans in motion. Establish team operating rhythm, performance expectations, and early program infrastructure. Begin demonstrating partner-influenced pipeline
12 Months: Deliver measurable business impact through ISV partner pipeline contribution, validated co-sell plays, and a growing set of active field relationships. Have a clear program framework in place with buy-in from Sales and Product leadership. Build and retain a high-performing team

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
